decision.explanation: Document d3 explicitly identifies Juliana Urtubey as the 2020 National Teacher of the Year, whereas document d2 refers to Tabatha Rosproy as the 2020 Kansas Teacher of the Year (a state-level title), creating a conflict where only Urtubey holds the national title; the fallible prior regarding Amber Benzon is disregarded due to lack of supporting evidence in the provided text.
